name: 33 kV busbar potential transformer
description: 33 kV busbar potential transformer for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. Procurement / Electrical. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts. Primary source: https://r.jina.ai/https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/explore/dataset/document_library/files/7da89b287743e31e5770b071642aea0c/download

specifications.metric: 33 kV inductive voltage transformer, o — nominal system voltage / highest voltage for equipment Um
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 Version 6.0, Date of Issue May 2024, Appendix 1 33kV table: 'Nominal System Voltage 33 kV'; 'Highest Voltage for Equipment Um (rms) 36 kV'.

specifications.metric: 33 kV inductive voltage transformer, o — rated short-time thermal current
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024), Appendix 1 33kV table: 'Rated short time thermal current Minimum 25kA for 3 secs but not less than that of associated HV Switchgear'. CONFLICT: the project line item prints '40kA (3s)'; this utility spec prints 25 kA/3 s minimum but requires not less than the associated switchgear, so a 40 kA/3 s bay would require at least 40 kA/3 s. Both statements

specifications.metric: 33 kV inductive voltage transformer, o — rated secondary voltage / ratio
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024), Appendix 1 33kV table: 'Rated Secondary Voltage 110/√3 V'; 'Ratios 33000/√3 : 110/√3'.

specifications.metric: 33 kV inductive voltage transformer, o — accuracy classes and output
specifications.unit: VA per winding; metering class 0.5, protection class 3P
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024), Appendix 1 33kV table: 'Metering: Class 0.5; Protection: Class 3P; Dual purpose: Class 3P / 0.5'; 'Output 50VA per winding'; 'Number of secondary outputs 3'.

specifications.metric: 33 kV inductive voltage transformer, o — voltage factor
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024), Appendix 1 33kV table: 'Voltage Factor 1.2 Continuous / 1.9 for 30 sec'.

specifications.metric: 33 kV inductive voltage transformer, o — lightning impulse withstand (dry impulse, peak)
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024), Appendix 1 33kV table: 'Rated insulation levels of the primary winding - (peak) - Dry Impulse 170 kV'.

specifications.metric: 33 kV inductive voltage transformer, o — power frequency withstand (wet 1 min)
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024), Appendix 1 33kV table: 'Rated insulation levels of the primary winding - (Wet 1min PF Withstand) 70 kV'.

specifications.metric: 33 kV inductive voltage transformer, o — minimum phase-to-earth creepage distance
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024), Appendix 1 33kV table: 'Minimum phase to earth creepage distance Dm<300mm 950mm'; pollution level 3 = 25 mm/kV (Heavy).

specifications.metric: 33 kV inductive voltage transformer, o — system earthing
specifications.basis: Northern Powergrid NPS/003/001 v6.0 (May 2024), Appendix 1 33kV table: 'System earthing C2) Impedance Earthed'. NOTE: this differs from the 132 kV table which states 'Solidly Earthed Neutral System'; conflict preserved.
